_comment: Dynamic paintings exported by tools/spine/export_paintings.py. hide: regexes of slot names that are scenery (background, weather, water) and are left out so the character stands on the desktop like the static no-background painting. expressions: optional [body, head] expression animations for the click reactions. ground_patch: keep the scenery right under the character (rows top..bottom fade in, optional columns left..right), for paintings whose character sits on its background.
